name: Advanced GSC
description:
Analyze your SEO and organic traffic performance inside Claude by connecting your own Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 data. Pull top queries and pages, follow click, impression, CTR, and position trends, compare date ranges, and investigate ranking or traffic drops. Audit any page for indexing, metadata, schema, redirects, internal links, and robots rules, find keyword cannibalization across your site, analyze backlink profiles and competitor link gaps, and check live SERPs including AI Overviews and People Also Ask.

Claude combines multiple analyses in a single conversation, cross referencing Search Console and Google Analytics, asking clarifying questions, and turning raw SEO and analytics data into clear, actionable recommendations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Advanced GSC to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Advanced GSC to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.advancedgsc.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Advanced GSC MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Advanced GSC lists 62 MCP tools, including analyze_ai_overview, analyze_paa, audit_sitemap, backlinks_aggregate, backlinks_audit, backlinks_compare, backlinks_competitive_analysis, backlinks_gap, backlinks_intersect_datasets, backlinks_list_datasets, backlinks_prune_my_datasets, and backlinks_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Advanced GSC?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Advanced GSC in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Advanced GSC MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Advanced GSC requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Advanced GSC is developed by Advanced GSC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
